title: Local View of the Oracle Source Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, $C$ a finite Turing machine over that alphabet with at least one work tape, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input word $x$ whose state is present. For either Boolean side and any dispatch state $q$, embedding the four-tape local configuration formed from the query tape of $c$, its head position, the input-head position, and output into the work tapes and head positions of the oracle source configuration yields that source configuration with its state replaced by $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ has at least one work tape
